title: Arsamnes
summary: Raleigh names Arsamnes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Arsamnes, named in the line by which Xerxes deriueth himselfe, between Ariaramnes and Hystaspes. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter II, §. IV, sig. 395b
